Bihar Police Promotion : kya bihar pulis men ab kaee puliskarmiyon ki kismat badalne vali hai...kya kisi ko milne vala hai daroga ka rutba, to kisi ke lie khulne vala hai tarakki ka naya rasta...bihar pulis vibhag men ek bara phaisla liya gaya hai..jiska asar hajaron puliskarmiyon ki jimmedari aur pad par parne vala hai.... lekin is phaisle men kise kya mila hai aur kitne puliskarmiyon ko iska phayda huaa hai....aaie puri khabar jante hain...
